newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady at $68, active - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady at $68, active - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active for a short period of time at midday in the Panhandle area on Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady with last week.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 22,500 slaughter steers and 11,400 heifers; 57,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00-67.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 1000-1150 lbs 66.00-67.00.
Wk to date - 57,400 Week ago - 33,200 Year ago - 80,000
